verses.text: For this reason, I, Paul, am a prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles.
Surely you've heard that God gave me this responsibility to share his grace with you.
God revealed the mystery to me, as I wrote briefly before.
When you read this, you'll understand my insight into the mystery of Christ.
People in earlier generations weren't told this mystery, but now the Spirit has revealed it to God's holy apostles and prophets.
The mystery is this: through the Good News, the Gentiles share the same inheritance, belong to the same body, and share in the promise in Christ Jesus.
I became a servant of this Good News through God's gift of grace, given to me by the working of his power.
Though I'm less than the least of all God's people, this grace was given to me: to announce to the Gentiles Christ's immeasurable riches,
and to make clear to everyone how God is carrying out the mystery that was hidden for ages in God, who created everything.
God's purpose was that now, through the church, his many-sided wisdom would be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
according to his eternal purpose, which he carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Through faith in Christ, we can approach God with freedom and confidence.
So I ask you not to lose heart because of my troubles for you. They are for your glory.
That's why I kneel before the Father,
from whom every family in heaven and on earth gets its name.
I pray that from the riches of his glory he will strengthen you with power through his Spirit in your inner being,
so that Christ may live in your hearts through faith. And I pray that you will be rooted and grounded in love,
so you can grasp, together with all God's people, how wide, long, high, and deep Christ's love is,
and know this love that goes beyond knowledge, so you may be filled with all God's fullness.
To the one who can do far beyond anything we ask or imagine, through the power working in us,
to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus through every generation, forever and ever. Amen.
